name: shinchantw_cbt_week4_activity_currency_20260803_102348_171836
sql:
/*
首周前四日运营活动与付费货币去向。活动按可验证的活动道具消耗口径：
游乐园=430002；繁体专属伙伴=430006；SG 开心福引机=10244。
不同版本缺少同名活动 ID 时返回“无已验证映射”，不把缺数写成 0。
*/
WITH Config AS (SELECT DATE '2026-07-29' tc_start,DATE '2026-08-02' tc_end,DATE '2026-05-08' sg_start),
TCB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SGB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SGC AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'),
SGA AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" u FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'),
M AS (SELECT '新加坡全体(iOS+Android)' grp,c.u FROM SGC c UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡Android',c.u FROM SGC c JOIN SGA a ON c.u=a.u),
ItemRows AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#account_id" aid,e."#event_name" ev,TRY_CAST(t.item_id AS BIGINT) item_id,TRY_CAST(t.before_qty AS BIGINT) before_qty,TRY_CAST(t.after_qty AS BIGINT) after_qty,TRY_CAST(t.diff AS BIGINT) diff
 FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Config c CROSS JOIN UNNEST(e.a_rst) AS t(item_id,item_key,before_qty,diff,after_qty,item_name) LEFT JOIN TCB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u
 WHERE e."$part_event"='item_change' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.tc_start AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.tc_end AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002','91110','91111')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT m.grp,e."#account_id",e."#event_name",TRY_CAST(t.item_id AS BIGINT),TRY_CAST(t.before_qty AS BIGINT),TRY_CAST(t.after_qty AS BIGINT),TRY_CAST(t.diff AS BIGINT)
 FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Config c CROSS JOIN UNNEST(e.a_rst) AS t(item_id,item_key,before_qty,diff,after_qty,item_name) JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.u LEFT JOIN SGB b ON e."#user_id"=b.u
 WHERE e."$part_event"='item_change' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.sg_start AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.tc_start,c.tc_end),c.sg_start) AS VARCHAR) AND b.u IS NULL
),
Activity AS (SELECT grp,CASE WHEN item_id=430002 THEN '游乐园兑换' WHEN grp='繁体CBT' AND item_id=430006 THEN '专属伙伴活动' WHEN grp<>'繁体CBT' AND item_id=10244 THEN '开心福引机' END activity,COUNT(DISTINCT aid) users,COUNT(*) events,SUM(ABS(COALESCE(diff,0))) qty FROM ItemRows WHERE before_qty>after_qty AND ((item_id=430002) OR (grp='繁体CBT' AND item_id=430006) OR (grp<>'繁体CBT' AND item_id=10244)) GROUP BY 1,2),
Sink AS (SELECT grp,ev,COUNT(DISTINCT aid) users,SUM(CASE WHEN item_id IN (10009,10206) AND before_qty>after_qty THEN ABS(COALESCE(diff,0)) ELSE 0 END) currency_spent FROM ItemRows GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT 'activity' "数据模块",grp "对比组",activity "项目",users "参与人数",events "触发次数",qty "消耗数量",NULL "货币消耗" FROM Activity
UNION ALL
SELECT 'currency_sink',grp,ev,users,NULL,NULL,currency_spent FROM Sink WHERE currency_spent>0
ORDER BY 1,2,7 DESC;
